transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'd like to call this meeting to order. We're here to review the operating plan for the one-night audience-participation recreation of a scene from our featured film. As you all know, the experience involves a movable scenic set, guided participant groups, and a marked route through the event space. Before I can give my final authorization, I need each technical or compliance lead to place any final findings into the shared record using the formal finding-report step. Once that's done, I'll record any resulting documentation or follow-up work as commitments — and those don't need to be completed during this meeting for me to sign off. So let's start: does anyone have findings to report, or are we ready to proceed?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a critical finding to report. During this morning's vendor load test, I confirmed that the planned 900 kg scenic unit cannot be moved through the event space safely. The certified alternative is two separate 300 kg carts. I have not yet entered this result in the operating plan, but I'm placing it into the shared record now via this formal finding-report step.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a compliance finding to report. I confirmed with the festival's insurer this afternoon that our coverage applies only when participant groups contain no more than 8 people and every participant signs the approved waiver. The written confirmation is still pending in my compliance inbox, but the verbal confirmation was clear. I'm placing this into the shared record now via this formal finding-report step.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. Jonah, your finding is clear — the 900 kg scenic unit is unsafe, and we'll go with the two 300 kg carts as the certified alternative. Selene, your compliance finding means we'll cap participant groups at 8 and require the approved waiver for everyone. Are there any other findings to report, or are we ready for me to record commitments and authorize the plan?
